title: 区分增量叙事解释中的修订与延迟细化
summary: 本文区分了叙事理解中两种结构不同的更新算子：修订驱动更新（非单调，撤回或替换已承诺结构）和延迟细化（单调，通过约束添加细化未指定元素）。使用视觉叙事作为诊断领域，展示结构化表示如何支持两种算子，并讨论其对增量推理和混合符号-神经系统的意义。
summary_en: This paper distinguishes two structurally different update operators in narrative interpretation: revision-driven update (non-monotonic, retracts or replaces committed structure) and delayed elaboration (monotonic, refines underspecified elements via constraint addition). Using visual narratives, it demonstrates how structured representations support both operators and discusses implications for incremental reasoning and hybrid symbolic-neural systems.
